products.name: CI Pipeline Optimizer
products.valueProposition: Reduce CI/CD costs by 60% and cut pipeline runtime from 35 minutes to under 12 minutes
products.timeline: 2 weeks to full deployment (includes monitoring setup)
products.description:
### Overview

Drop-in replacement for GitHub Actions / GitLab CI that intelligently caches dependencies, parallelizes tests, and predicts which tests to run.

### Key Features

- Smart caching (73% hit rate)
- Predictive testing (90% accuracy)
- Parallel execution
- Cost optimization
products.integrationRequirements:
### Requirements

- GitHub/GitLab repository access
- Cloud account (AWS or GCP)
- Node.js 18+ or Python 3.9+ project

### Setup Time

- Initial configuration: 2 hours
- Migration: 1 week
- No code changes required
